unshield 1.6.2 (https://github.com/twogood/unshield, MIT licence, see LICENSE), library sources only
(lib/ and lib/md5/, the RSA Data Security, Inc. MD5 Message-Digest Algorithm). Used by the Windows
desktop build to unpack the retail installer's DATA1.CAB (InstallShield 5) when installing the game
from disc 1 (Unreal/Src/KHGDiscImport.cpp). lib/unshield_config.h is written by hand for MinGW-w64.
